name: account_settings
description: Read the account's quota windows, or set the output language when output_language is given. The language setting slot is not live-verified (the call is sent, but Google may ignore or reject it).

arguments.name: output_language
arguments.desc: language code to set, for example en or de; omit to only read

name: auth_login
description: Not available through MCP: sign-in needs the local credential store, and cookies should not pass through a chat. Returns UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT with the CLI command to run instead (sourcebolt login --import, --browser or --attach).

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: import (cookies or file), browser or attach

arguments.name: profile
arguments.desc: account profile name

arguments.name: host
arguments.desc: NotebookLM host, for example notebook.google.com

arguments.name: file
arguments.desc: path of a cookie export file (method import)

name: auth_logout
description: Not available through MCP: the credential store is only reachable from the CLI. Returns UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT with the command to run instead (sourcebolt logout).

arguments.name: profile
arguments.desc: account profile name

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: must be true to delete the stored session

name: chat_ask
description: Ask a question about a notebook's sources. Streams partial text as progress notifications. Returns the answer, citations (source, cited text, UTF-16 offsets) and the conversation id. save_as_note also saves the answer as a note (note_id, or note_error when it could not be saved). wait=false returns a job_id; poll with chat_status. Not retried after sending.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: question
arguments.desc: the question to ask

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: restrict the answer to these sources (id, id prefix or title); default all sources

arguments.name: conversation_id
arguments.desc: continue this conversation; default is the notebook's newest thread

arguments.name: new_conversation
arguments.desc: start a fresh conversation instead of the default thread

arguments.name: wait
arguments.desc: wait for the answer (default true); false returns a job_id to poll with chat_status

arguments.name: save_as_note
arguments.desc: also save the answer as a note, as the web app's Save to note does (the server picks the note title)

name: chat_configure
description: Change a notebook's chat settings: mode (default, learning_guide, or custom with custom_prompt) and response_length (default, longer or shorter). Unset fields keep their value. mode default with response_length default resets the notebook to the web app's defaults.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: conversational goal; custom needs custom_prompt

arguments.name: custom_prompt
arguments.desc: instructions for mode custom, up to 10000 characters

arguments.name: response_length
arguments.desc: response length

name: chat_history
description: Read a notebook conversation (oldest turn first within a page), with cursor paging. format=markdown adds a rendered transcript. Turn layout is not yet live-verified.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: conversation_id
arguments.desc: conversation to read; default is the newest thread

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: max turns per page (default 20)

arguments.name: cursor
arguments.desc: next_cursor of the previous page (older turns)

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: json (default) or markdown

name: chat_status
description: Status and result of a detached chat_ask (wait=false): running, done, failed or cancelled. Jobs live in memory and are dropped an hour after they finish or when the server restarts.

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: job id returned by chat_ask with wait=false

name: delete
description: Delete notebooks, sources, notes, artifacts, chat history, labels or collections. Without confirm:true it only returns a preview of what would be deleted and changes nothing. Items are matched strictly (exact id, unique id prefix or exact title) against a fresh list. source, note and chat_history need notebook; chat_history deletes the whole history of the given conversations; it reaches only the newest 20 conversations of a notebook, and its preview shows their created and updated times and, when the whole history can be read, the first question. Kinds artifact, label and collection are not available yet and return UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT.

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: notebook, source, note, artifact, chat_history, label or collection

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, prefix or title; required for every kind except notebook

arguments.name: ids
arguments.desc: ids (or exact titles) of the items to delete; for chat_history, conversation ids

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: must be true to delete; without it only a preview is returned

name: job_cancel
description: Cancel a running detached job (chat_ask with wait=false, deep research). For an ask with a known conversation the server-side generation is also stopped, best effort.

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: job id to cancel

name: label_list
description: List a notebook's source labels with emoji and the ids of the sources in each. Collections are not available yet.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: source_labels (default); collections are not available yet

name: label_update
description: Rename a label, set its emoji, or add/remove sources. Actions auto and create (and notebook collections) are not available yet and return UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT. Payload shapes are not live-verified.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: source_labels (default)

arguments.name: action
arguments.desc: rename, set_emoji, add_sources or remove_sources (auto and create are not available yet)

arguments.name: label
arguments.desc: label id or name

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: new name for rename

arguments.name: emoji
arguments.desc: emoji for set_emoji

arguments.name: items
arguments.desc: source ids, id prefixes or titles for add_sources / remove_sources

name: note_list
description: List the notes of a notebook with id, title and content. Deleted notes are not shown.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: include_mind_maps
arguments.desc: accepted for compatibility; mind maps are not listed yet

name: note_save
description: Create a note, or update an existing one (note = id or title). from_turn (save a chat turn as a note) is not available yet and returns UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: existing note id or title to update; omit to create a new note

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: note title

arguments.name: content
arguments.desc: note body

arguments.name: from_turn
arguments.desc: save a chat turn as a note (not available yet)

name: notebook_create
description: Create a notebook with a title and optionally add sources in the same call (same items as source_add). The create call is sent once and never retried. emoji is accepted but ignored (no known wire slot). If the rename or the source add fails, the notebook still exists and its id is returned with warnings.

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: title of the new notebook

arguments.name: emoji
arguments.desc: notebook emoji (ignored: no known wire slot yet)

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: sources to add right after creation; same items as source_add

name: notebook_list
description: List NotebookLM notebooks with id, title, source count and ownership. Filter by title and scope. Returns 20 by default; has_more says whether to page with offset. Cached 30 s.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: case-insensitive filter on notebook titles

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: mine, shared or all (default all)

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: max notebooks to return (default 20; page with offset)

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: skip this many notebooks

arguments.name: refresh
arguments.desc: bypass the 30 s cache

name: notebook_open
description: Open one notebook by id or title: its sources with status, summary and suggested questions.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

name: notebook_update
description: Rename a notebook (title, verified by read-back) and/or drop it from the recently viewed list (remove_from_recent). emoji, pinned, alias and tags are not available yet and are ignored with a note.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: new title

arguments.name: remove_from_recent
arguments.desc: drop the notebook from the recently viewed list

arguments.name: emoji
arguments.desc: not available yet (ignored)

arguments.name: pinned
arguments.desc: not available yet (ignored)

arguments.name: alias
arguments.desc: not available yet (ignored)

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: not available yet (ignored)

name: research_import
description: Import research candidates as notebook sources, by urls (from research_status), report, or all. Candidates are matched by URL against a fresh read, so results reordered since research_status still import the intended ones; an unknown URL is NOT_FOUND. Candidates already in the notebook are skipped, so a retry is safe. Reports added, skipped and failed per candidate.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: job
arguments.desc: research job id from research_start or research_status

arguments.name: urls
arguments.desc: URLs of the web candidates to import, as listed by research_status

arguments.name: report
arguments.desc: also import the deep-research report candidate

arguments.name: all
arguments.desc: import every candidate

name: research_start
description: Start a web or Drive research job in a notebook (fast or deep). Returns a job handle; poll with research_status, then import with research_import. Queries under 4 words are rejected unless force is true. Mode discover is not yet available (UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT).

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: what to research; at least 4 words unless force is set

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: fast (default) or deep; discover is not yet available

arguments.name: corpus
arguments.desc: web (default) or drive; deep supports web only

arguments.name: force
arguments.desc: allow a query shorter than 4 words

name: research_status
description: Check research jobs of a notebook and list their candidates (pick them by url in research_import). With wait_seconds (0-120) polls every 3 s, reporting progress, until the job is done.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: job
arguments.desc: research job id; omit for all jobs of the notebook

arguments.name: wait_seconds
arguments.desc: 0-120: poll every 3 s until the job is done or time runs out

arguments.name: include_report
arguments.desc: include the deep-research report text

name: server_info
description: Show the sourcebolt version, active Google profile, NotebookLM host, enabled tools and which transport served the last call. No Google call unless include_usage is set.

arguments.name: include_usage
arguments.desc: also fetch account tier and quota windows (one Google call)

name: share_status
description: Show who a notebook is shared with and whether the link is public.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

name: share_update
description: Change notebook sharing: link visibility (public) and per-user roles (viewer, editor, remove). Widening access or removing people requires confirm:true; without it a preview is returned and nothing is sent. The link setting and the user changes are sent as two calls; if only one applies, status is partial and parts says which applied and which failed. Payload shapes are not live-verified. view_level and artifact sharing are not available yet.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: public
arguments.desc: true = anyone with the link can view, false = restricted

arguments.name: users
arguments.desc: per-user changes

arguments.name: notify
arguments.desc: email the added people

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: message to include in the notification

arguments.name: view_level
arguments.desc: full or chat_only (not available yet)

arguments.name: artifact
arguments.desc: share one artifact instead of the notebook (not available yet)

arguments.name: confirm
arguments.desc: required to widen access or remove people; without it only a preview is returned

name: source_add
description: Add sources to a notebook: public URLs (YouTube auto-detected) and pasted text, in one call. Returns a per-item outcome. Drive and file items are not yet available (UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT). URLs to private or internal addresses are rejected.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: items
arguments.desc: sources to add; each item sets exactly one of url, text, drive, file

name: source_list
description: List a notebook's sources with type and processing status; optionally filter by status.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: filter: processing, ready, error, preparing or a raw status number

name: source_read
description: Read a source's full text, markdown, or guide (summary and keywords), paged by character offset (max_chars default 20000; see truncated and next_offset).

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: source id, id prefix or title

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: fulltext (default), markdown, or guide (the source guide: summary as text plus keywords)

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: character offset to start from

arguments.name: max_chars
arguments.desc: max characters to return (default 20000, cap 200000)

name: source_update
description: Rename a source (title) and/or check whether it is up to date (check_freshness). refresh is not yet available (UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT).

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: source id, id prefix or title

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: new title

arguments.name: refresh
arguments.desc: re-fetch the source (not yet available)

arguments.name: check_freshness
arguments.desc: report whether the source is up to date

name: studio_generate
description: Generate a Studio artifact: audio, video, report, interactive_report, slide_deck, mind_map, quiz, flashcards, infographic or data_table. Each kind takes only the option values a live capture has proven (the enums); other values the web app offers return UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT naming the option, before any call. Omitted options take the web app's defaults. instructions is optional for audio, video, slide_deck and quiz, required for report, mind_map, flashcards and data_table, and refused by infographic and interactive_report (each as captured). video.generate_later asks for deferred generation (cinematic format only). report needs report.title and report.description plus instructions as the prompt (suggest surface report returns ready-made triples). Checks the account quota first and returns a QUOTA error when it is used up. Artifacts are built from the notebook's sources only, not notes (the web app can add notes; that is not supported). Returns the new artifact as pending; poll studio_list for its status. Not retried after sending.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: the artifact kind

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: source ids, id prefixes or titles; default all sources (notes cannot be used as sources)

arguments.name: instructions
arguments.desc: free text: audio and video focus, slide deck description and quiz topic (optional); report prompt, data table description, mind map and flashcards topic (required); infographic and interactive_report take none

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: output language code as the web app sends it (default en; cinematic video takes none)

arguments.name: audio
arguments.desc: options for kind audio

arguments.name: video
arguments.desc: options for kind video

arguments.name: report
arguments.desc: options for kind report (required)

arguments.name: slide_deck
arguments.desc: options for kind slide_deck

arguments.name: quiz
arguments.desc: options for kind quiz

arguments.name: flashcards
arguments.desc: options for kind flashcards

arguments.name: infographic
arguments.desc: options for kind infographic

name: studio_list
description: List a notebook's Studio artifacts (audio, video, report, slide_deck, mind_map, quiz, flashcards, infographic, data_table) with kind and status (pending while queued or generating, then ready or failed). Pass artifact to read one with its interactive content (HTML or mind-map tree) when Google has any.

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

arguments.name: artifact
arguments.desc: one artifact id or title; returns it with its interactive content when available

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: filter by kind: audio, video, report, slide_deck, mind_map, quiz, flashcards, infographic, data_table (interactive and unknown for unrecognized rows)

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: filter by status: pending (queued or generating), ready or failed

name: suggest
description: Suggested prompts for a surface: chat, report or studio_options. The followups surface is not yet available (UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT until a live capture pins it).

arguments.name: notebook
arguments.desc: notebook id, id prefix or title (not needed for studio_options)

arguments.name: surface
arguments.desc: chat, followups, report or studio_options

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: limit to these sources (id, id prefix or title)

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: steer chat suggestions toward this topic
